native_context.input_scope: Item index supplied to each original actor-selection branch. No menu or dialogue replay.

actual_verification_scope.fixture_scope: The copied Lisbon save already held the equipped Sextant. The original transfer supplied Eagle Figurehead and Frozen Rose, and the original flag setter enabled Advice. Ordinary inputs displayed and dismissed the three Hans portraits.
